timeline.text: Seven repos. One feature. And I could never remember which repo touched it last.
I'd search my way through all seven, chasing a commit that could be anywhere.
It was like searching seven filing cabinets for one receipt, one drawer at a time.
Now GitHub Actions scans every repo on each push and builds one map straight to the exact commit.
One click now finds it. Debugging time dropped seventy to eighty percent.
